literal_groups.message: remove discourse filler and state the fact directly
use established technical terms instead of AI-style wording
replace colloquial wording with a concrete state or action
state the exact operation without anthropomorphizing software
remove formulaic AI wording and state the concrete claim
state the failed operation and available recovery instead of apologetic or casual UI wording
replace region-bound slang with standard Chinese

regex_rules.message: use 執行/执行 for an action or 運行/运行为 an ongoing state
replace colloquial installation wording with the exact install action

regex_rules.pattern: (?:同步|服務|服务|程式|程序|進程|进程|任務|任务|連線|连接)[^，。！？\n]{0,6}(?:掛了|挂了)
regex_rules.message: state the failed component and operation

regex_rules.pattern: 通過.{0,10}的方式|通过.{0,10}的方式
進行(?:了)?(?:構建|同步|下載|安裝|驗證|檢查)|进行(?:了)?(?:构建|同步|下载|安装|验证|检查)

regex_rules.message: name the direct action instead of a 對…進行 construction

regex_rules.pattern: (?:(?:大大|極大|极大|顯著|显著|有效)(?:地)?(?:提升|提高|改善|優化|优化)|(?:提升|提高|改善|優化|优化)(?:了)?(?:穩定性|稳定性|可靠性|可用性))(?![^，。；：\n]{0,20}(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?%|[一二三四五六七八九十]+倍))
regex_rules.message: state the measured change instead of a vague improvement claim

regex_rules.pattern: (?:確認|确认|檢查|检查|設定|设置|選擇|选择|使用)[^。！？\n]{0,6}[「『][\u4e00-\u9fff]{1,8}[」』](?=(?:目錄|目录|檔案|文件|選項|选项|功能|按鈕|按钮|欄位|字段|參數|参数|變數|变量|值|鍵|键|路徑|路径))
regex_rules.message: do not wrap ordinary Chinese terms in full-width brackets; use backticks for identifiers
use Chinese punctuation after Chinese text

regex_rules.pattern: (?:本文|本篇|這篇文章|这篇文章)(?:將|将|會|会)?(?:深入)?(?:探討|探讨|介紹|介绍|分析|解析|說明|说明|旨在)
regex_rules.message: start with the subject and claim instead of narrating the article

regex_rules.pattern: (?:更加|更為|更为)(?:便捷|高效|智慧|智能|強大|强大|靈活|灵活|卓越)
regex_rules.message: replace promotional adjectives with a concrete property or measured result

regex_rules.pattern: (?:請|请)?(?:點擊|点击)(?:此處|此处|這裡|这里)
regex_rules.message: name the action or destination instead of a positional click instruction
use one ongoing-state marker, not both 正在 and 中

regex_rules.pattern: 發生(?:了)?(?:一個)?錯誤|发生(?:了)?(?:一个)?错误
regex_rules.message: state the operation that failed and the affected object

regex_rules.pattern: (?:確定|确定)(?:要)?(?:這麼做|这么做|這樣做|这样做|嗎|吗)[？?]?
regex_rules.message: name the confirmed action, object, and effect

grammar_rules.pattern: (?:跑|走|讀|读|寫|写|做|執行|执行|運行|运行|處理|处理|載入|载入|下載|下载|上傳|上传|編譯|编译|建置|构建|安裝|安装|啟動|启动|停止|回應|响应|工作)的(?=(?:很|更|太|較|较|比較|比较|相當|相当|非常|極|极|夠|够)?(?:快|慢|好|差|穩定|稳定|順利|顺利|完整|正確|正确))
grammar_rules.message: use 得 between a verb and its degree complement

grammar_rules.pattern: (?:快速|迅速|直接|自動|自动|依序|逐一|單獨|单独|重複|重复)的(?=(?:執行|执行|處理|处理|檢查|检查|載入|载入|下載|下载|上傳|上传|更新|安裝|安装|啟動|启动|停止|建立|讀取|读取|寫入|写入|傳送|传送))
grammar_rules.message: use 地 when the modifier describes how an action is performed

grammar_rules.pattern: (?:認真|认真|專業|专业|負責|负责)地(?=(?:態度|态度|方式|方法|作風|作风))
grammar_rules.message: use 的 when the modifier describes the following noun
